title: Lost in Transcription: Identifying and Quantifying the Accuracy Biases of Automatic Speech Recognition Systems Against Disfluent Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems by comparing performance metrics—specifically Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), and semantic accuracy (BERTScore)—on audio datasets containing disfluent speech (stuttering) versus non-disfluent speech, using both real-world recordings and synthetically generated datasets.
